turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, got it. It must be nice to have a quieter house. How have you been holding up since getting back from Ana's wedding in San Antonio?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've been doing well! The wedding was beautiful, and it was so great to see Ana. It was nice to be back in Texas, even if it was a totally different vibe than when I went for the half marathon.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! A wedding is definitely a different pace than a half marathon. Have you had any time to play your guitar lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I actually practiced for about an hour this morning. It's been a really nice, relaxing Saturday so far.
